candidateAudit.text: The first release from Ethiopia has arrived!🍑🥭🍊 Shantawene Kebena | Arbegona Peach | Mango | Orange Ethiopia Natural | 74110, 74112 imported via primavera.coffee The producers of this lot of coffee are part of the Shantawene Kebena community, with a couple of local languages spoken (Sidaamu and Amharic). Shantawene village is nestled between the villages of Bombe and the majestic Bombe mountain. As is customary in much of Ethiopia, the local growers in this area are primarily smallholders, referred to as “garden farmers.” This term originates from their practice of cultivating coffee in the garden areas surrounding their homes. Additionally, many of these farmers harvest coffee cherries from trees that grow on the land where they reside. This natural occurrence of coffee trees in the birthplace of coffee, Ethiopia, is a testament to its rich coffee heritage. In the region surrounding Shantawene village, there are two distinct rainy seasons. The first, known as Belg, occurs during the short rainy period from late February to May. Following Belg, the main rainy season, known as Kiremt, spans from June to September. The annual rainfall in this area typically ranges from 47 to 78 inches, contributing significantly to the lush vegetation and fertile soil that are conducive to coffee cultivation. These alternating rainy seasons play a crucial role in providing the necessary moisture for coffee plants to thrive and produce high-quality cherries.  The Bensa district is situated within the renowned coffee-producing region of Sidama in Ethiopia. candidateAudit.title: Am Badeschiff kann man wieder SALSA lernen! Der nächste BASIC I-Kurs startet am Mittwoch, den 16.09.2026! Dauer: 6 Wochen (Einstieg ab 2. Woche auch noch möglich), Preis für 6 Woch
candidateAudit.text: Am Badeschiff kann man wieder SALSA lernen! Der nächste BASIC I-Kurs startet am Mittwoch, den 16.09.2026! Dauer: 6 Wochen (Einstieg ab 2. Woche auch noch möglich), Preis für 6 Wochen 90 Euro (über a Bailar Viena). Du möchtest Salsa Cubana von Grund auf lernen und dabei echtes kubanisches Lebensgefühl erleben? Dann komm zu unserem Basic I Workshop mit Vassi & Yunel. Schritt für Schritt lernst du die wichtigsten Basics, Rhythmus, Bewegung und das typische kubanische Feeling. Keine Vorkenntnisse notwendig! Für Leader: Du lernst, klar und angenehm zu führen, deine Schritte sicher mit der Musik zu verbinden und dich dabei locker und mit Leichtigkeit zu bewegen. Für Follower: Du lernst, die Führung gut wahrzunehmen und darauf zu reagieren, dich frei und mit Leichtigkeit zu bewegen und dabei deinen eigenen Stil und Ausdruck zu entwickeln. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Schritte: Leader und Follower lernen miteinander zu tanzen, aufeinander zu reagieren und gemeinsam die Musik zu genießen. 🙌 Kein Tanzpartner notwendig! Komm alleine, mit Freunden oder mit deinem Partner – bei uns sind alle willkommen. 📅 Mittwoch | 16.09. – 14.10., + 28.10. 18:00 Salsa Cubana Basic 1 19:00 Salsa Cubana / Timba Improvers 20:00 Salsa Cubana /Timba Intermediate 21:00 Social Dance – Salsa & Bachata & More 📩 Info & Anmeldung: anmeldung@abailarviena.at Die wundervollen Fotos sind von Leila Winkler leila2luciaa

candidateAudit.text: Chrome auf Nude – der Glanz, der nicht nach Glitzer aussieht. Der Effekt liegt nicht in der Farbe, sondern in der Reflexion: kein Schimmer, kein Glitter, eine glatte Spiegelfläche. Im Licht wandert der Ton ins Perlmutt, im Schatten bleibt er nude. Mandelform, lange Länge, absolut ebene Oberfläche – Chrome verzeiht keine Unebenheit, deshalb entscheidet hier die Vorarbeit. Termine über den Link in Bio 💙 G×Bar Grace Vienna 🇺🇦 Хром на нюді — блиск, який не виглядає як глітер. Ефект не в кольорі, а у відбитті: без шимеру, без блискіток, гладенька дзеркальна поверхня. candidateAudit.text: Suprise coffee release!🌞 Damian Bolaños | Finca Buena Vista Caturra | Washed Stone Fruit | Mandarin | Red Apple imported via semillacoffee Damián grew up between the town of San Agustín and his family’s farm in La Muralla. Long walks to the farm, days of fieldwork, and the shared routines of rural life shaped his early years. After finishing school in 2012, he worked in retail and later for an agricultural supply company, where visits to farms across southern Huila allowed him to learn new cultivation techniques and invest both knowledge and income back into his family’s farm. In 2015, Damián and his family moved permanently to La Muralla and gradually built the infrastructure needed to process their own coffee. Previously, they had relied on neighboring farms to ferment and dry their harvests, often selling coffee before processing was complete. A turning point came in 2017, when their coffee placed among the top fifteen lots in the Best of Huila competition. The experience encouraged Damián to pursue specialty coffee more seriously and to focus on improving both quality and processing. After several years working with a regional coffee exporter, Damián dedicated himself fully to his own farm. Through his collaboration with the MonKaaba project, he continued refining his production while also working as an assistant sample roaster. Today, he sees specialty coffee as the result of continuous learning, perseverance, and a commitment to producing coffees that reflect both his family's work and the potential of their farm. candidateAudit.text: A LIFE IN LAYERS Art Exhibition at Market Island by Marlis Dsouza artsybym A collection of works from across Marlis Dsouza’s artistic journey, bringing together pieces from ‘NEW Wave’, ‘FEAR-LESS’, The ‘Marlis’ Collection, and ‘One for the Pages’. Each collection represents a different chapter from taking the leap, confronting fear, learning self-love, and giving form to the thoughts that are often left unsaid. Together, the works become something more than separate collections. They become a portrait of a life in progress. Layered with fear, courage, uncertainty, love, growth, and everything in between. Because we are never just one version of ourselves. We are everything we’ve been, everything we’re carrying, and everything we’re still becoming. 📍Market Island, Dubai Festival City Mall. candidateAudit.title: Oops all Uganda subscription this month! One washed, one natural, both amazing❤️‍🔥 Kyabwire Best Coffee Farmers | Kazingo - Rwenzori Mountains Pineapple | Wine Gum | Raspberry Uga
candidateAudit.text: Oops all Uganda subscription this month! One washed, one natural, both amazing❤️‍🔥 Kyabwire Best Coffee Farmers | Kazingo - Rwenzori Mountains Pineapple | Wine Gum | Raspberry Uganda SL 28 | Natural imported via semillacoffee The coffees from the Kaybwire communities reflect Semilla and Empaako Collective’s commitment to working with producers at the margins of the global coffee trade. Most farmers in the villages of Nyango, Lwabana, and Kighumu cultivate less than 0.75 acres of coffee, with some managing plots of under 0.25 acres. Individual harvests are often extremely small—sometimes yielding less than 18 kilograms of exportable green coffee—making collaboration and collective processing essential to bringing these coffees to market. A central role in this effort is played by Kajumba Stella, known locally as Atenyi, who coordinates coffee collection and harvest documentation for eleven producers in the Kaybwire area. Despite limited infrastructure and unreliable internet access, she learned to use digital tools to record deliveries and organize transparent payments, making it possible for Empaako Collective to prepare and export three separate lots during the project's first harvest season. For many producers, this represents an alternative to long-standing challenges within the local coffee trade. In the past, farmers experienced fraudulent buying practices, including unpaid deliveries, non-transparent pricing, and manipulated weighing scales. candidateAudit.title: We have Cascara on the shelf now!🍒 What is Cascara you ask? Cascara is the dried outer husk of the coffee cherry, the fruit that surrounds the coffee bean. Once the beans are remo
candidateAudit.text: We have Cascara on the shelf now!🍒 What is Cascara you ask? Cascara is the dried outer husk of the coffee cherry, the fruit that surrounds the coffee bean. Once the beans are removed, the remaining pulp and skin are dried. When brewed, cascara yields a light, tea‑like drink with gentle notes of cherry, raisin, and honey, also continig a little bit of caffeine. It makes use of a part of the coffee plant that's usually discarded. Pro Tip: Put some cascara in a pot with water an gently boil it for an hour. This makes concentrate that you can then dilute with water, put over ice, make syrups with etc. Like this the taste is more reminiscent of cola or ripe tea. Super fun ingredient to play around with!

candidateAudit.title: Short and sweet - some mermaid transitions to play with this week 😍 Tips to make it work: Make sure to position the bases’s toes close to the elbow crease of the flyer. Flyers: gr
candidateAudit.text: Short and sweet - some mermaid transitions to play with this week 😍 Tips to make it work: Make sure to position the bases’s toes close to the elbow crease of the flyer. Flyers: grab the base’s heel or ankle so you can pull strongly and slow down your movements. Bases can “walk” their hands on the flyer’s back for more support. For the way back in, use a tempo (lean out, lean in). Bases: point toes a bit to give a better platform in the inversion. To land back in bird, flyers pull the feet where they want them then release the hands and bases receive deeply, point (!) and extend the legs. Have fun ✨ Please have a spotter if you try this for the first time! if the base loses the line towards the back, flyer lands on their head 😵‍💫 ————————————————————————- Hey there :) we are Hannah & Alexis, Acroyoga and handstand teachers and founders of acroyoga.vienna On this page we share our favourite Acroyoga flows, what’s happening in our studio in Vienna and snippets of life with an acro baby 👶 happy if you follow and stick around ❤️ #acroyogavienna #acroyogawien #acroyogaflow #acroyogastudio acroyogacours

candidateAudit.title: Goodbye, Meli! ❤️🚢 Zwei Jahre lang war Meli im Rahmen ihres Praktikums Teil des Badeschiffs – und es war eine große Freude, mit ihr zusammenzuarbeiten. Mit ihrem Fleiß und ihrer o
candidateAudit.text: Goodbye, Meli! ❤️🚢 Zwei Jahre lang war Meli im Rahmen ihres Praktikums Teil des Badeschiffs – und es war eine große Freude, mit ihr zusammenzuarbeiten. Mit ihrem Fleiß und ihrer ordentlichen Arbeitsweise hat sie schnell einen Platz in der Crew gefunden und uns mit ihrer fröhlichen Art und ihrer Offenheit immer wieder zum Lachen gebracht. Was Meli am meisten vermissen wird? 💛 Ihren Kollegen Georg – oder besser gesagt: mit ihm zu lachen und ihn auch mal zu ärgern. Georg hat ihr immer geduldig alles gezeigt, alle Fragen beantwortet und war dabei jederzeit für einen Schmäh zu haben. 💛 Ihre Chefin Steffi, die sie nie mit einer Herausforderung allein gelassen hat. 💛 Die Bierfässer, die für sie aussahen wie kleine, dicke Schweinchen. 🐷🍺 💛 Das genüssliche Zertreten von Kartons. 💛 Das liebe Küchenteam. 💛 Und ganz besonders den schwarzen Staubsauger, der – da ist sich Meli sicher – einfach viel besser gesaugt hat als alle, die danach gekommen sind. 😄 Liebe Meli, wir danken dir für die gemeinsame Zeit, für dein Lachen, deine Herzlichkeit, deine Arbeit und dein Engagement. Wir wünschen dir von Herzen alles Gute für deinen weiteren Weg! 🍀 Auch das Facility-Team möchte nochmal ganz besonders Danke sagen; wir werden dich sehr vermissen, du warst eine super Kollegin! Hoffentlich sehen wir uns bald wieder! Du bist bei uns am Badeschiff jederzeit herzlich willkommen, alles Liebe und sonnige Grüße von der gesamten Crew des Badeschiffs! ❤️🚢

candidateAudit.text: First release for July is out!❤️‍🔥 Reinaldo Chilito | El Paraiso Nectarine | Orange | Florals Colombia Pink Bourbon | Washed imported via semillacoffee Reinaldo was born and raised in El Purutal, San Agustín, Huila, where agricultural work shaped daily life from an early age. Limited access to education meant he left school after the second grade and spent much of his childhood helping his family cultivate sugarcane, panela, corn, beans, cassava, and coffee. Through years of work on his parents’ farm and neighboring properties, he developed the skills and experience that would later allow him to establish his own agricultural project. At fourteen, Reinaldo received a small portion of his family’s land to cultivate independently. Alongside seasonal work on neighboring farms, he gradually saved enough money to purchase a plot of his own. With support from Colombia’s coffee growers federation, he planted his first 800 Caturra trees and began building the foundation of his coffee farm. Together with his wife, Mariela, whom he met in his early twenties, he expanded the farm over the following decades, acquiring additional land and steadily increasing coffee production while continuing to grow food crops for household use. In 2016, Reinaldo planted 3,000 Pink Bourbon trees after seeing the success of the variety on neighboring farms. As he learned more about specialty coffee, he became interested in producing coffees with higher quality potential and greater value. candidateAudit.text: Suprise! It's time for another Release!🌟 Eliecer Nuñez Osorio | Finca Mirador Apricot | Rosehip Tea | Panela Colombia Colombia | Washed imported via semillacoffee Don Eliecer Nuñez Osorio was born and raised in Ricabrisa, Tarqui, Huila, where coffee cultivation has long been part of everyday life. Established in 1923, the farm spans over 1000 hectares, with a significant portion dedicated to coffee cultivation across multiple varieties. It is part of the Sancoffee cooperative, which focuses on quality-driven production and building long term relationships between producers and international buyers. Within this scale, coffees like this are separated as “Farm Select” lots. These are traceable to a single farm and represent a step toward more differentiated quality in a context where production is often associated with volume. This approach allows producers to receive more direct value for quality while maintaining the efficiency that defines Brazilian coffee production. Harvesting combines manual and mechanical methods, with a focus on collecting ripe cherries. After harvest, the coffee is processed as a natural. Cherries are spread on patios or drying beds and left to dry intact for around 20 to 25 days, depending on weather conditions. During this time, the fruit slowly dries around the seed, and the coffee is regularly turned to ensure even drying and prevent defects. candidateAudit.text: 🍇🌱In the shadow of the Uhudler Grapes. People often describe our garden restaurant as an oasis or hidden gem in the middle of the city—and that’s no coincidence! A great deal of time and love goes into caring for our garden, and you can see and feel the difference. From the very beginning, preserving the typical tree population of a traditional Viennese guest garden—walnut, chestnut, and linden trees—has been just as important to us as planting new ones. Another key source of shade in summer are the “Uhudler” grapevines, which wind their way through our garden and bring the unique charm of a countryside Heuriger into the heart of the city. Nestled between the mqwien and the bustling Mariahilferstraße shopping district, we offer a retreat from the summer heat—and in winter, thanks to our sheltered location, protection from the cold Viennese wind. During the Advent season, a cup of punch or mulled wine in our garden can make you forget the chill altogether. #glacisbeisl #moderntavern #vienneseclassic

candidateAudit.text: 🌱🍇Circus @ Glacis Beisl With Aci Urbajs and his wines Glacis Beisl started the journey towards natural wine about 15 years ago. Together with radikonwines , terpin_wine and vina_cotar, organic.anarchy turned a simple pleasure drink into an experience, opened the door to a whole new world (which in fact is not new, but you know what we mean 😉) and made us focus on the origin of wine: nature. Through respect for nature, wines like Organic Anarchy are created. Unconventional and unpredictable, a vibrant product that becomes even more alive and tangible once you get to know the people who create it. That’s why it was both a pleasure and a great joy for us to welcome Aci and his Circus to Glacis Beisl. To bring the spirit of his Rifnik vineyard to the center of Vienna and share it with others. It was also a pleasure to see that the idea of Kmetija Urbajs has now begun to be handover to the younger generation Tina and Ziga, who create wine, cider, fermented tea and many more products Rifnik is gifting. candidateAudit.text: This release is super special!🔥 Oscar Hernandez | Los Nogales Lavender | Lemon Verbena | Lime Colombia Orange Bourbon | Washed & Dried with Lavender imported via chicas_industry Oscar is a third-generation farmer who grows coffee in the south of the department of Huila, near the town of Bruselas. He is an energetic person, always positive and innovative, not only for his family but also for the wider environment. His father, Ricaurte Hernandez, was the first to prove what we know today: that the best coffees from all over Colombia can be found in Bruselas. In 2006, he won the Colombian Cup of Excellence and, as the locals say, spread the word. Ricaurte put Bruselas, and the entire department of Huila, on the map of fine coffee. Oscar continues this tradition, and thanks to him and his approach, Nogales is a centre of innovation and information for all the proactive farmers in the area. This coffee comes from the Yarumo lot at Finca Nogales, where Orange Bourbon is grown exclusively at the highest point of the farm. The variety has adapted to cooler conditions while still benefiting from strong sunlight due to its position. As one of the newer plantings, it is continuously observed and refined, with each harvest offering new insights into its potential. Production at Finca Nogales emphasizes careful selection and controlled processing. Harvesting is done manually, with pickers selecting only fully ripe cherries to preserve the integrity of the variety. candidateAudit.text: ✨ Opernball 2026 aus dem Salon Campari Während im großen Saal Walzer und Glamour die Nacht eröffneten, entstand im Salon Campari unser ganz eigener Opernballmoment — getragen von Aperitivo‑Stimmung, guten Gesprächen und dem Team der Bar Campari. 🍸 Der Negroni dell’Opera Edizione 2026 gab dem Abend seinen Charakter: ein speziell für den Opernball kreierter Signature‑Drink, der die Wiener Nacht um eine italienische Note bereicherte. candidateAudit.text: Heute erreichen in Indien die farbenfrohen Feierlichkeiten des Diwali – des Lichterfestes – ihren Höhepunkt. Traditionell werden kleine Öllämpchen entzündet, Häuser erstrahlen im warmen Licht, und Menschen beschenken einander mit süßen Leckereien. Diwali erinnert uns daran, dass Hoffnung und Licht selbst die dunkelsten Zeiten erhellen können. Anlässlich dieses Festes erhalten Sie heute zu jeder Bestellung eine indische Süßigkeit als kleine Aufmerksamkeit von uns. Die Aktion gilt in unserer donauzentrum Filiale, solange der Vorrat reicht. Glückliches Diwali 🪔! #diwali #happydiwali #bombayexpress #deepavali
